reimport decides which lists are of a catalogued faction itself (builder.js catalogued on the checked-in data.js) and fails a catalogued list whose verify/out/from-json-<list>.json does not say list.from builder.js with list.same true (no list field: a from-json.js that no longer calls builder.js; refused; or from-json's reading not builder.js's), and a list of another faction not from from-json.js's own reading. So neither code path can change a catalogued list's entry without the other: a builder.js change fails P1 (build-parity) and reimport; a from-json.js change fails reimport.

Every hand-file field of the six catalogued lists, and where a phone import gets it: source (nidzillas, lite-knights): a fact of the list itself (the day its PDF was exported), the phone's says when it was imported, P1 and P2 leave the source line aside. units.<id>.why, gists.<id>.by, refs[].why: reasons, nothing shown. units.<id>.texts (Malign Presence, Will of the Hive Mind, One Head Looks Back, Altered Reality, Daemonic Allegiance) and units.<id>.notes (Malign Presence, Seed Spore Mines, Split, Horrors are Pink…): on the DATASHEETS rows builder.js reads (the texts also declared in verify/deviations-words.json; Chaos Daemons' also in verify/sources/hand/catalog-chaos-daemons.json texts). refs (tzeeeeentch: Blue Horrors, Brimstone Horrors): builder.js's sheetRefs finds both from GW's words, on DATASHEETS rows (the Brimstone Horrors row exists only from this hand file: no BSData entry). gists (gist, gistOf, note) and armyRules FAQs: FACTIONS rows, every list's. No catalogued hand file has ids, short, kwOnly, partialRules, stats or kw.

Not retired, and why: from-json's own list reading still serves the 18 uncatalogued lists, and for a catalogued list it is what verify/tables.js --write derives DATASHEETS from (the rows' list-decided facts: deviations-catalog's, the hand texts and notes, the stats rows' part by the models lines' gear), so it cannot go before those facts are the catalogue's alone. For a catalogued list it no longer writes the entry: it is the independent check the gate holds byte for byte to builder.js's.
